# Casos de línea de comandos comparados con el plugin de Java (tools/oracle/hash_oracle.sh).
# Una invocación por línea, argumentos separados por espacios. Se ejecutan con el
# directorio de trabajo en la raíz del árbol de tree.manifest; $TREE es su ruta
# absoluta y ../h contiene una copia de testdata/hash.
createdigest
createdigest -help
createdigest no-existe.txt
createdigest sub/hola.txt
createdigest sub/hola.txt -halgorithm SHA-1 -hformat B64
createdigest sub/hola.txt -halgorithm sha-512 -hformat b64
createdigest sub/hola.txt -hformat foo
createdigest sub/hola.txt -hformat xml
createdigest sub -hformat hex
createdigest sub/hola.txt -hformat bin
createdigest sub/hola.txt -o
createdigest sub/hola.txt -o a -o b
createdigest sub/hola.txt -x
createdigest sub/hola.txt -xml -hformat foo
createdigest sub/hola.txt -halgorithm FOO
createdigest sub/hola.txt -halgorithm FOO -xml
createdigest sub/hola.txt -o ../no-existe/x.hexhash
createdigest $TREE/no-existe
checkdigest
checkdigest -help
checkdigest -xml
checkdigest sub/hola.txt
checkdigest -i sub/hola.txt
checkdigest sub/hola.txt -i no-existe
checkdigest sub/hola.txt -i sub/hola.txt
checkdigest sub/hola.txt -i ../h/java-hola-sha256.hexhash
checkdigest sub/hola.txt -i ../h/java-hola-sha256.hashb64
checkdigest sub/hola.txt -i ../h/java-hola-sha256.hash
checkdigest sub/hola.txt -i ../h/java-hola-sha1.hexhash
checkdigest sub/hola.txt -i ../h/java-hola-sha384.hash
checkdigest sub/hola.txt -i ../h/java-hola-sha512.hashb64
checkdigest vacio.txt -i ../h/java-hola-sha256.hexhash
checkdigest sub/hola.txt -i ../h/hola-sin-h.hexhash
checkdigest sub/hola.txt -i ../h/hola-crlf.hashb64
checkdigest sub/hola.txt -i ../h/hola-url.hashb64
checkdigest $TREE -i ../h/java-sha256-rec.hashfiles
checkdigest $TREE -i ../h/java-sha1-norec.hashfiles
checkdigest $TREE -i ../h/java-sha512-rec.txthashfiles
checkdigest $TREE -i ../h/java-sha384-norec.txthashfiles
checkdigest $TREE -i ../h/corrupto.hashfiles
checkdigest $TREE -i ../h/sin-extension
checkdigest $TREE/sub -i ../h/java-sha256-rec.hashfiles
